decisions.reason: The portable reference-class electrometer is a flagship close to the firm's core dosimetry business, so it costs little to keep, and featuring it on the home page shows the firm is still committing to it while its market prospects resolve.

The oncology risk management software is a low-cost software option that builds on the firm's QA platform and fits its patient-safety direction, and its value is still too uncertain only one year after launch to justify abandoning it.
